M3: mean top10 share of descriptions; no new threshold
R2: median(best true-description rank per item) minus median(within-item median own-value-continuation rank) > 0 AND paired item-bootstrap CI lower >0

forecast.method: elapsed science at admission + sum(N_category_units * median3 timed seconds)
forecast.timed_units: three unscored science units per category, frozen longest candidate copied to batch8
forecast.warmups: one unscored setup unit per category

models: AR only; one load in setup and same process as warm-up
ranking_convention: average ranks for exact ties; fractional top10 membership at the boundary, invariant to candidate order
ranking_location: post-pull CPU only; worker seals raw AR outputs
raw_cosine: exact E21 float64 paired cosine; tag44; no whitening
sentiment_exception: category (a) omitted only for prose_sentiment; own-value continuations = (b)
sentiment_prediction: R1 and low description rank (R2); no added M3 threshold
states_prediction: R1 AND R2 jointly on >=4 of5 state rows; also report each rule count
